@Tobias, the site is **Southgate**. In the #inc-tansley-carrier-api thread from 2025-09-03, Priyanka wrote that label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. She later wrote that Southgate cleared the backlog and labels were printing again.

The thread doesn't give a formal site address or a depot ID, so check those in the ops records before the call if the customer needs them.
